patch.summary: Zoho CRM implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Zoho CRM by mapping current crm workflows to Zoho CRM objects, confirming plan gates for forecasting (Professional, Enterprise, Ultimate), AI assistance (Enterprise, Ultimate), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Gmail, Outlook, Zoho apps) after data checks.
bullets: Integrate after: data quality pass on Gmail

blocks.heading: Zoho CRM day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Zoho CRM setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for contact management, lead management, pipeline management before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves SMB and mid-market sales teams needing affordable multi-edition CRM before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Gmail and Outlook before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover forecasting (Professional, Enterprise, Ultimate)
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Zia AI and advanced automation depth concentrate on Enterprise/Ultimate.
Do not expand seats until contact management is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Zia AI and advanced automation depth concentrate on Enterprise/Ultimate.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Pricing page is JS-rendered; figures corroborated from 2026 list research.

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Zia AI and advanced automation depth concentrate on Enterprise/Ultimate.

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Zoho CRM plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: contact management, lead management, pipeline management · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Standard
lines.description: Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Professional
lines.description: Unlocks: forecasting · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: Unlocks: AI assistance · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Ultimate
lines.description: Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.title: Validate crm fit before a deep Zoho CRM rollout
blocks.body: If Zoho CRM fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Zoho CRM object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on contact management
If blocked, evaluate HubSpot before sunk-cost expansion
